title: Nrf2 and Detox Support - Nutrition Education from WholisticMatters
abstract:
## Nrf2 Activators: The Brassicas  
Consuming a higher intake of[brassica vegetables](https://wholisticmatters.com/cruciferous-vegetables-phytonutrient-powerhouse/)has been associated with a decreased risk of chronic disease and the potential to reduce cancer risk through Nrf2 activation.1,2Key phytochemicals in these plants are able to bind to Nrf2 and have been referred to as “Nrf2 activators.” They have been shown to protect against oxidative stress, exert cytoprotective and neuroprotective effects, and induce phase two detoxification enzymes when consumed through the diet.3-5Though many phytochemicals have been identified as activators of Nrf2-signaling mechanisms, those which have been studied the most extensively include curcumin from turmeric (*Curcuma longa*), and[sulforaphane](https://wholisticmatters.com/a-novel-broccoli-extract-antioxidant-and-anti-inflammatory/)from the*Brassicaceae*family of plants and – in particular – from broccoli.
